explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Code must be in position 3." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Code → Edict → Accord → Deed → Bill
- Edict → Accord → Deed → Bill → Code

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "verified_key_agreement"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): Independently enumerated all 120 permutations of Accord, Bill, Code, Deed, Edict. Rules Code must occupy position 1 or position 5. Accord must precede Deed. Bill and Edict must not occupy consecutive positions. Exactly 1 other item must occur between Accord and Bill. leave 2 valid orders: Code>Edict>Accord>Deed>Bill; Edict>Accord>Deed>Bill>Code. Choice true counts: a=1, b=0, c=1, d=1; impossible requires zero matches.
